# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_RECLAIM_BURST

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A break of the opening‑range high accompanied by a volume surge and immediate VWAP reclaim signals strong intraday momentum. The condition is stricter than a simple ORB retest because it requires the breakout bar to close above VWAP and exhibit elevated volume, filtering for high‑conviction continuation moves.

## Mechanism

Within the first 30 minutes after market open (09:30‑10:00 ET), compute the opening‑range high (ORH) and low (ORL) from the first 5‑minute bars. On each 5‑minute bar, check: (1) bar.high > ORH, (2) bar.volume > 1.5 × the average volume of the first 20 bars of the session, (3) bar.close > VWAP (calculated from session open to that bar). When all three are true, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: stop at the lower of ORL or the breakout bar’s low; target at 2× risk or when price closes below VWAP; optionally trail a runner with a premium‑stop of 15% of ATR. The strategy is disabled when VIX < 10 or > 22, and during the first 15 minutes after major economic releases.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** The trigger is designed for ITM‑2 0DTE puts/calls. A qty of 28 contracts (typical for a $25K account) assumes ~$25K+ equity; a $1K paper account would realize roughly 14% of headline P&L due to position‑sizing limits.
2. **Sample bias:** No historical sample has been evaluated yet; selection method is N/A. Overfit risk is high until a Stage‑1 backtest is performed on an in‑sample window.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk‑forward held‑out window not yet executed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation on the top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst‑case day could be a failed breakout that reverses sharply, hitting the stop at ORL or the breakout bar low; max drawdown could exceed 50% of allocated capital if multiple consecutive failures occur; blow‑up scenario involves trading during low‑VIX (<10) chop where breakouts frequently fail and stops are hit repeatedly.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until backtest completes; will disclose top‑5‑days percentage of P&L once data is available.
